description:
Embr Studio turns your Apple TV into the control room for your Twitch stream. Keep it on the TV beside your setup and see what matters while you're live, from across the room.

YOUR CHAT, BIG
• Chat at a size you can read from the sofa, with Twitch, 7TV, BetterTTV and FrankerFaceZ emotes
• Mentions and first-time chatters stand out; Play/Pause freezes chat so you can read a long message
• Moderate with the Siri Remote: pin, delete, time out, ban, shout out, report and block
• Quick messages, chat modes and Shield Mode one click away

THE AD CLOCK
• Your next mid-roll counting down, with the snoozes you have left
• Snooze it, or run a break of the length you choose
• A banner and a chime a minute before, and a countdown while viewers watch ads

EVERY MOMENT
• Follows, subs, gifted subs, cheers, Power-ups, raids and channel point rewards as they happen
• Hype trains, polls, predictions and goals live over chat
• A warning with Shield Mode one click away when a spam wave hits

BUILT FOR LONG STREAMS
• Keeps the Apple TV awake while you're live and lets it sleep when you're not
• Burn-in protection for OLED TVs
• When you're offline: your next scheduled stream and a recap of the last one

FOR MODERATORS
• Open Studio for a channel you moderate, with AutoMod's held messages beside chat

TRY IT FIRST
• A sample stream shows every moment before you sign in

STUDIO PRO
Snoozing and running ads, alert sounds, the stream recap, moderator mode and quick messages are part of Studio Pro: monthly, yearly or a one-time purchase. Every streamer gets a week of Pro from their first live stream in Studio, with nothing to sign up for. Studio Pro works on Apple TV, iPhone and iPad with the same Apple Account.

Embr Studio shows your own channel through Twitch's official API and plays no video. Sign in with your own Twitch account on your phone; Embr never sees your password.

promotionalText: Your Twitch stream's control room on the TV: big chat, the next ad break counting down, and every follow, sub and raid as it happens.
